label: Model Risk Audit Framework
description: Third-line internal-audit framework for auditing financial-crime and credit models — transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, credit scoring, synthetic-identity detection. Builds the model audit universe, risk-based scope, and test procedures across data lineage, tuning governance, validation independence, bias, explainability and DORA/EU AI Act evidence.

claudeKnowledge.description: EU AI Act, DORA RTS/ITS, BCBS 239, SR 11-7 / ECB TRIM model governance, EBA validation guidance, IIA / ISACA model-audit practice

guidedInputs.label: Known issues, prior findings or supervisory focus
guidedInputs.description: Describe any prior audit findings, validation backlog, supervisory letters, near-misses, or model-performance concerns.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. TM thresholds last tuned 2022 with no below-the-line testing; validation function reports to the model owner, not independently; no inventory entry for the new GenAI alert-summarisation tool; FI flagged sanctions fuzzy-match calibration in last SREP; credit scorecard PSI breaching amber for 3 quarters with no action.

exampleInput: We are a Nordic mid-tier bank (group ~3,500 FTE) with a Swedish parent and branches in Finland and Norway. Internal Audit needs a board-grade model-risk audit framework and a first-year plan. The model estate includes a vendor transaction-monitoring platform (rules plus a newer ML anomaly layer), a sanctions screening engine, an IRB credit PD model, a behavioural application-fraud / synthetic-identity model, and a recently piloted GenAI tool that drafts SAR narratives and summarises alerts for investigators. We have a second-line validation team but they sit within the CRO's model-development reporting line, and the GenAI tool was deployed by the financial-crime ops team outside the model inventory. We need to (1) build the model audit universe and a risk-based 12-month plan, and (2) define the test procedures for a first deep-dive on transaction monitoring — covering data lineage, threshold tuning governance, validation independence, performance monitoring and the human-in-the-loop alert workflow — and show how this intersects DORA TLPT and EU AI Act obligations. Audit Committee wants an opinion on whether model risk is adequately controlled.

exampleValues.known_concerns: Validation team reports into the CRO's model-development line — independence questionable. GenAI SAR-drafting tool deployed by FC ops outside the model inventory, no risk classification under the AI Act. TM ML anomaly layer is a vendor black box with no local explainability evidence. Sanctions fuzzy-match thresholds never below-the-line tested. IRB PD scorecard PSI amber for 3 quarters with no documented action.
